description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.021 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. SEC EDGAR Schedule 13D/13G beneficial ownership disclosures for US equities. Mode 1 (ticker): returns all 5%+ shareholders for a company — activist funds (13D) vs passive holders (13G), with ownership %, share count, and EDGAR filing URL.
